shots.purpose: The emptiness the laughter resonates in, as material rather than as a joke.

Show the whole series at once before the chain walks it, using the artist's own composite. The backdrop is a MOTION asset (g01's drift at this dim was too small to register as movement) and is NOT a02: a02 is a figure marked no_crop, and a backdrop covers, which cut its sequence apart and doubled the same picture at two scales.

Light each transformation as it is spoken and keep it lit, so the finished chain is the argument rather than a travelling highlight. Carries a dimmed backdrop because a diagram holding one state for 7.6s reads as a still picture to the no-static-passage gate - a caption change alone is too few pixels to count as movement.
The fifth transformation as the object it produced: the block, turning, inscribed on chain.
The set as a population being priced - scarce, fixed, and valued by whoever holds it.
Close on the coin the film opened on, under the essay's own words for what the work finally is.
